symbols.name: wire count
symbols.meaning: The number of wires in the network.
symbols.quote: Subspace labels attach nested nondegenerate subspaces to the vertices of the [Linear exchange network with restored scratch wires](linear-network.md), so that its total rank stays below $Wm$ ($W$ wires, label dimension $m$).

symbols.name: label dimension
symbols.meaning: The dimension of the label space, equal to h^3.
symbols.quote: Subspace labels attach nested nondegenerate subspaces to the vertices of the [Linear exchange network with restored scratch wires](linear-network.md), so that its total rank stays below $Wm$ ($W$ wires, label dimension $m$).

symbols.name: ground-set size
symbols.meaning: The size of the ground set from which triples are drawn, 100.
symbols.quote: Let $h=100$ be the ground-set size, $\mathcal T$ the 3-element subsets of $\{1,\dots,h\}$, $N=\binom h3^3$ the number of indices $a\in\mathcal T^3$, $I$ the invocation count ($I/N=3/\binom h3$), and $c$ the central wires per invocation ($c_{\rm b}=100$, $c_{\rm c}=101$).

symbols.name: set of triples
symbols.meaning: The set of 3-element subsets of the ground set.
symbols.quote: Let $h=100$ be the ground-set size, $\mathcal T$ the 3-element subsets of $\{1,\dots,h\}$, $N=\binom h3^3$ the number of indices $a\in\mathcal T^3$, $I$ the invocation count ($I/N=3/\binom h3$), and $c$ the central wires per invocation ($c_{\rm b}=100$, $c_{\rm c}=101$).

symbols.name: number of indices
symbols.meaning: The number of indices a in T^3, each with data roles X_a and Y_a.
symbols.quote: Let $h=100$ be the ground-set size, $\mathcal T$ the 3-element subsets of $\{1,\dots,h\}$, $N=\binom h3^3$ the number of indices $a\in\mathcal T^3$, $I$ the invocation count ($I/N=3/\binom h3$), and $c$ the central wires per invocation ($c_{\rm b}=100$, $c_{\rm c}=101$).

symbols.name: invocation count
symbols.meaning: The number of invocations of the network.
symbols.quote: Let $h=100$ be the ground-set size, $\mathcal T$ the 3-element subsets of $\{1,\dots,h\}$, $N=\binom h3^3$ the number of indices $a\in\mathcal T^3$, $I$ the invocation count ($I/N=3/\binom h3$), and $c$ the central wires per invocation ($c_{\rm b}=100$, $c_{\rm c}=101$).

symbols.name: central wires
symbols.meaning: The number of central wires per invocation.
symbols.quote: Let $h=100$ be the ground-set size, $\mathcal T$ the 3-element subsets of $\{1,\dots,h\}$, $N=\binom h3^3$ the number of indices $a\in\mathcal T^3$, $I$ the invocation count ($I/N=3/\binom h3$), and $c$ the central wires per invocation ($c_{\rm b}=100$, $c_{\rm c}=101$).

symbols.name: label field
symbols.meaning: The field Q^h or F_2^h carrying the bilinear form from which labels are built.
symbols.quote: Bit network: label field $F=\mathbb Q^h$ with $\langle x,y\rangle=x^{\mathsf T}(\mathbf 1-J/9)y$, $J=\mathbf 1\mathbf 1^{\mathsf T}$ (eigenvalues $1,-91/9$).

symbols.name: triple indicator
symbols.meaning: The indicator vector in F of the triple T.
symbols.quote: With $t_T$ the indicator of a triple $T$, $t_S^{\mathsf T}t_T=|S\cap T|$ and $t_S^{\mathsf T}Jt_T=9$ give $\langle t_S,t_T\rangle=|S\cap T|-1$, so each line $\langle t_T\rangle$ is nondegenerate and neighbors ($|S\cap T|=1$) are orthogonal

symbols.name: index vector
symbols.meaning: The tensor of the three triple indicators of the index a.
symbols.quote: Labels live in $\mathcal F=F^{\otimes3}$ of dimension $m=h^3$, with $u_a=t_{a_1}\otimes t_{a_2}\otimes t_{a_3}$, $U_a=\langle u_a\rangle$.

symbols.name: stage space
symbols.meaning: The tensor power F^{⊗(j-1)} of the factors already exposed at stage j.
symbols.quote: At stage $j\in\{1,2,3\}$ let $A=F^{\otimes(j-1)}$, $P=\langle t_{a_1}\otimes\cdots\otimes t_{a_{j-1}}\rangle$, $B=P^\perp\subset A$, $t$ the $j$th indicator, $R$ the line of later factors:

symbols.name: stage line
symbols.meaning: The line spanned by the tensor of the first j-1 triple indicators.
symbols.quote: At stage $j\in\{1,2,3\}$ let $A=F^{\otimes(j-1)}$, $P=\langle t_{a_1}\otimes\cdots\otimes t_{a_{j-1}}\rangle$, $B=P^\perp\subset A$, $t$ the $j$th indicator, $R$ the line of later factors:

symbols.name: stage complement
symbols.meaning: The orthogonal complement of P inside A.
symbols.quote: At stage $j\in\{1,2,3\}$ let $A=F^{\otimes(j-1)}$, $P=\langle t_{a_1}\otimes\cdots\otimes t_{a_{j-1}}\rangle$, $B=P^\perp\subset A$, $t$ the $j$th indicator, $R$ the line of later factors:

symbols.name: later factors
symbols.meaning: The line spanned by the tensor of the later triple indicators.
symbols.quote: At stage $j\in\{1,2,3\}$ let $A=F^{\otimes(j-1)}$, $P=\langle t_{a_1}\otimes\cdots\otimes t_{a_{j-1}}\rangle$, $B=P^\perp\subset A$, $t$ the $j$th indicator, $R$ the line of later factors:

symbols.name: total dimension lost
symbols.meaning: The total dimension lost on decreasing edges.
symbols.quote: Only central edges $3\to4$ decrease, losing $P\otimes F\otimes R$ of dimension $h$, so the total dimension lost is $L=Ich$.

relations.predicate: price each change of frame from
relations.quote: Labels price each change of frame, from [Frames on wire arrays](common-frame-principle.md), at its residual's dimension.
An edge's residual is the orthogonal complement of the smaller label in the larger, defined in [Rank, subspaces and orthogonal complements](linear-algebra-basics.md).

derivations.quote: With $t_T$ the indicator of a triple $T$, $t_S^{\mathsf T}t_T=|S\cap T|$ and $t_S^{\mathsf T}Jt_T=9$ give $\langle t_S,t_T\rangle=|S\cap T|-1$, so each line $\langle t_T\rangle$ is nondegenerate and neighbors ($|S\cap T|=1$) are orthogonal
With $A'=A\otimes F$, $P'=P\otimes\langle t\rangle$, $B'=(P')^\perp_{A'}$, $R=\langle t_{a_{j+1}}\rangle\otimes R'$, so outgoing equals next incoming.

Orthogonal neighbors give $\langle t_S\rangle\subset t_T^\perp$, so edge $2\to5$ nests. Only central edges $3\to4$ decrease, losing $P\otimes F\otimes R$ of dimension $h$, so the total dimension lost is $L=Ich$. Signed changes telescope at each gate to $Wm-2N$; absolute values add $2L$.
So $L_{\rm b}/N=100/539$ and $L_{\rm c}/N=101/539$, both below $1/2$

Bit interface: assign each vertex the projection $P_U$ onto its label, and $-P_{U_a}$ at the source of $X_a$. For nested nondegenerate $U\subset V$, $P_V-P_U$ is the identity on $V\cap U^\perp$ and zero elsewhere, so has rank $\dim V-\dim U$. On the $N$ first edges of $X_a$, $2P_{U_a}$ has rank $1$, not $0$. So $s_{\rm b}=Wm-N+2L_{\rm b}<Wm$, and at the endpoints $P_{U_a^\perp}+P_{U_a}=\mathbf 1$.
